scope: Conceptual episode of the active fixed-mode synthetic formulation. No generated sample, fitted prediction or athlete trace.

predictors.label: Known horizon
predictors.text: The requested H24, H48 or H72 is known at origin. It is not the future outcome.

predictors.label: Current baseline
predictors.text: Force, net impulse and depth from a dedicated pre-exposure assessment.

predictors.label: Participant context
predictors.text: Training age and strength. Hidden participant response effects are excluded.

predictors.label: Current exposure
predictors.text: Public exposure descriptors. The latent load factors that generated them stay hidden.

predictors.label: Four prior episodes
predictors.text: Each prior record has 17 fields: baseline, exposure and later outcomes that were already observed before the current query.

events.label: Prior episodes
events.title: History is already observed.
events.text: Four earlier episode records provide examples of baseline, exposure and subsequent response. Their observations precede this forecast; their spacing here is schematic.

events.label: Baseline CMJ
events.title: Measure a reference, before exposure.
events.text: A dedicated assessment about two hours before exposure supplies force, net impulse and depth. Later innovations are changes relative to this baseline.

events.label: Exposure / origin
events.title: Freeze the information boundary.
events.text: Current baseline, context, exposure, four prior episodes and requested horizon are available. The model commits its forecast before any current future outcome is observed.

events.label: 24 h assessment
events.title: A later assessment becomes a target.
events.text: Force and net impulse are measured from the same concentric phase. Their baseline-relative innovations are scoring targets, never current-query predictors.

events.label: 48 h assessment
events.title: Another horizon, another target cell.
events.text: The requested horizon was known at origin; the measured outcome was not. Each outcome and horizon has its own normalization for scoring.

events.label: 72 h assessment
events.title: Score the forecast, with the boundary intact.
events.text: The six outcome/horizon cells receive equal weight. Observing a target later does not make it an input to this earlier forecast.

layers.label: World
layers.title: The process behind the measurement
layers.text: The generator controls correlated exposures, hidden participant and camp effects, fixed 24 h / 84 h modes and bounded smooth discrepancy. A learner is not given those hidden effects.

layers.label: Observation
layers.title: One phase, two related measurements
layers.text: Each assessment averages three valid paired trials. Force and net impulse come from the same concentric force trace; measurement discrepancy and noise are not exposed as predictors.

layers.label: Predictor
layers.title: A deliberately restricted view
layers.text: 82 public fields encode to 84 numeric columns for ridge. No labels, identity keys, future realizations, hidden effects or random-generator states enter. Transformations are fitted on training data only.

layers.label: Scorer
layers.title: Compare a forecast with a later observation
layers.text: RMSE is divided by the truth population SD inside each of six cells. Six normalized errors are averaged equally. This research metric is not the unimplemented production score.

worlds.label: Repair the observation
worlds.text: Derive both outcomes from one concentric trace. Retain the episode response law.

worlds.label: Change the exposure
worlds.text: Volume, speed, change and internal factors create correlated loads; public descriptors are the model inputs.

worlds.label: Question the response
worlds.text: A participant-weighted high/low threshold is a different hypothesis. No accepted successor or evaluated live forecast is implied.

worlds.label: Anchor the response
worlds.text: Fix mathematical modes at 24 and 84 hours, with bounded smooth discrepancy. These are not biological compartments.
